 By Anna Maria Giano 
 Say Goodbye to Sleek Bobs — Pamela Anderson, 59, Is Bringing
Back Vintage-Inspired Curls, and It’s Her Most Glamorous Look
Yet
 Tousled blonde ringlets met a crisp white shirt and a sweeping
pistachio skirt, fresh as a spring morning.
 Pamela
Anderson arrived at the Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles
on October 17 with a halo of tousled blonde curls, and the whole
red carpet suddenly felt lighter. The 59-year-old star paired her
bouncy new texture with Carolina Herrera , choosing
a look from Wes Gordon’s Spring 2027 collection. Her make-up stayed
fresh and glowy, with flushed cheeks and a soft pink lip. Fans
noticed the change instantly, and the photos spread across social
media within hours. It is a playful, romantic beauty moment that
feels both vintage and completely modern. Above all, it confirms a
reinvention that keeps getting better with every single
appearance.
 Pamela Anderson’s Vintage-Inspired Curls
 The curls sit short and airy
around her face, with an undone volume that feels effortless. Their
bounce recalls a 1960s starlet on holiday on the Riviera. They also
cap a year of bold hair experiments, from a chin-length red bob to
shaggy ringlets with a sculptural fringe.
 The Carolina Herrera Look
 Pamela tucked a crisp white
shirt, left open at the collar, into a voluminous pistachio skirt
with a bow at the waist and a sweeping train. The pairing nods to
the white shirt that Mrs. Herrera made her signature, and to Sharon
Stone’s legendary 1998 Oscars look. A pale green satin clutch and
delicate gold jewelry finish it off.
 Why Pamela Anderson’s Style Reinvention Works
 Her transformation began in 2023, when she stepped out
with a bare face at Paris Fashion Week. Since then, she has chosen
a softer, more personal beauty, while The Last Showgirl 
earned her Golden Globe and SAG nominations. These curls feel like
the perfect next chapter, proof that confidence is her favorite
accessory.
